changelog: Item-level parcels in AST PRO's format (products_list: { product, item_id, qty } objects, '' for the whole order), so AST PRO reads them. Domain\ItemAllocation refuses an item not on the order, a quantity that isn't above zero, and more than is left to ship (ordered, less refunded, less other parcels). The order box has a folded "Items in this parcel" on orders with more than one unit; emails say "In this parcel: …" and My Account adds an "In this parcel" column when any parcel lists items.

REST: AST PRO's sku and qty fields on POST, its wc-ast-pro/v3 namespace, and products_list in responses. New errors ctracking_unknown_sku, ctracking_sku_qty_mismatch, ctracking_unknown_item, ctracking_bad_qty, ctracking_too_many.
CSV import: sku and qty columns; rows repeating an order and tracking number with a SKU each are one parcel. The preview shows an Item column.

Fulfillments\CoreSync: when WooCommerce's Order Fulfillments feature is on, each parcel is a fulfilled Fulfillment (items, number, provider mapped by Domain\CoreProviders, link, ship date) linked by _ctracking_tracking_id, and Fulfillments created, changed or deleted in WooCommerce change the tracking. No emails or status changes from syncing. A background copy (Action Scheduler) covers orders from before the feature was on. Filter ctracking_sync_fulfillments.

Domain\MoreCarriers: 1,028 more carriers from AST's full list (TrackShip's), written by tools/more-carriers.php, off until switched on with "Add from the full list" in the carriers settings. Tracking saved with any of their slugs resolves its name and link while off.
My Account's tracking block steps aside when WooCommerce lists the order's shipments itself (Order Fulfillments on and fulfilled).
TrackingService::update() takes an optional $strict (default true), as add() does.
The REST response has a sixth field, products_list (an empty list for whole-order parcels).
